description: Export #authority remote-reliability and route-policy functions across the shared C ABI boundary in apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.{coax,bridge.{h,c}} (#14032, from chat ba6d40e0).

steps.send: Export the `#authority` remote-reliability and route-policy functions across the shared C ABI (#14032): 1) In `apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax`, load `coax/lib/agent/environment/route-policy.coax` and add `#export_c` wrappers `mc_rr_sync_action`, `mc_rr_request_liveness`, `mc_route_select`, and `mc_cred_audience_ok` delegating to `rr_sync_action`, `rr_request_liveness`, `route_select`, and `cred_audience_ok`, with `#test` checks. 2) Add matching C ABI wrappers `oa_mobile_rr_sync_action`, `oa_mobile_rr_request_liveness`, `oa_mobile_route_select`, and `oa_mobile_cred_audience_ok` in `apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.h` and `apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.c`. 3) Verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax --library` and verify the generated C header + `client-core-bridge.c` compile cleanly under `clang -Wall -Werror`.

graders.run: grep -q 'mc_rr_sync_action' apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax && grep -q 'mc_route_select' apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax && grep -q 'oa_mobile_rr_sync_action' apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.h && grep -q 'oa_mobile_route_select' apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.c && grep -q 'oa_mobile_cred_audience_ok' apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.c && coax/bin/coax test apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax --library && mkdir -p /tmp/wf007-abi && coax/bin/coax c apps/shared/antigravity/client-core.coax --library --header /tmp/wf007-abi/client_core.h > /tmp/wf007-abi/client_core.c && /usr/bin/clang -std=gnu11 -Wall -Werror -I/tmp/wf007-abi -Iapps/shared/antigravity -c apps/shared/antigravity/client-core-bridge.c -o /tmp/wf007-abi/bridge.o && rm -rf /tmp/wf007-abi
